title: Fossiles
description: Once more the Ancient Beasts Came to rule the world!
body:
![Fossiles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2fef950a6f4cba71dacffd571e29e237233a45d.png)

**Fossiles is a mod about about prehistoric beasts, focusing on adding various of dinosaurs, cenozoic animals and more, Fossiles is in early access but will get alot of features in the future like, more beasts, dinosaurs, ores, and tools**

**Fossiles** currently adds

-2 beasts (Orodromeus, Sacabampaspis)

-2 new foods (Sacabampaspis raw, cooked)





- A mod made by Crifish
- Currently contains 2 creatures
- Feel free to use in modpacks
- You can suggest what beasts should be in the mod 

Requires geckolib

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41e3b3ba44d68c36d95ef88cbcdf6358baf4c960_0.webp)

[Download Geckolib here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)
